title: Composer: one draft per room and when a draft may be sent
spec: Implement Composer in crates/ui-model/src/composer.rs as its doc comments say: drafts are stored per room exactly as typed; submit trims leading and trailing whitespace only, refuses Empty and TooLong (more than MAX_DRAFT_CHARS chars, counted after trimming) and keeps the draft on refusal, and on success returns Command::Post and clears only that room's draft. Replace the `_todo` field and remove the clippy::todo allow. No new dependencies.
